response.sql: WITH funding_counts AS (SELECT p.fundflux, COUNT(DISTINCT p.arcregistry) AS project_count FROM scanqc AS q JOIN projects AS p ON p.arcregistry = q.arcref GROUP BY p.fundflux) SELECT fundflux, project_count, CAST(project_count AS DECIMAL) / SUM(project_count) OVER () AS fraction_of_total, CAST(project_count AS DECIMAL) / AVG(project_count) OVER () AS ratio_to_average FROM funding_counts

assumptions.assumption: Funding sources with no projects having QC records are omitted; the average is over the funding-source groups shown.

alternatives.interpretation: Show every funding source present in projects, including sources with zero projects having QC records.
alternatives.sql: WITH funding_counts AS (SELECT p.fundflux, COUNT(DISTINCT q.arcref) AS project_count FROM projects AS p LEFT JOIN scanqc AS q ON q.arcref = p.arcregistry GROUP BY p.fundflux) SELECT fundflux, project_count, CAST(project_count AS DECIMAL) / NULLIF(SUM(project_count) OVER (), 0) AS fraction_of_total, CAST(project_count AS DECIMAL) / NULLIF(AVG(project_count) OVER (), 0) AS ratio_to_average FROM funding_counts
